name: Qianhe Condiment and Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Qianhe Condiment and Food Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production and sale of high-quality soy sauce, vinegar, cooking wine, and other condiments. It offers vinegar, oyster sauce, cooking wine, caramel color, caramel color liquid, caramel color powder, caramel color for bakery, caramel color for beverages, caramel color for seasonings; and soy sauces, such as raw, light, dark, low sodium, organic, seasoned, sashimi, gluten-free, solidified, and powder, as well as provides OEM services. Qianhe Condiment and Food Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Meishan, China.
